sanskrit_verse: त्रैवार्षिकाधिकान्नो यः स हि सोमं पिबेद् द्विजः । प्राक्सौमिकीः क्रियाः कुर्याद् यस्यान्नं वार्षिकं भवेत् ॥
transliteration: traivārṣikādhikānno yaḥ sa hi somaṃ pibed dvijaḥ / prāksaumikīḥ kriyāḥ kuryād yasyānnaṃ vārṣikaṃ bhavet //
sph_interpretive_translation: A dvija who has surplus grain beyond three years' requirement shall offer soma; prior to the monsoon season, he shall perform appropriate rituals where annual grain sufficiency is established.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in surplus capacity — spiritual duty arises from material excess.
Causation flows from abundance — ritual obligation manifests when provisioning exceeds necessity.
Capacity-based responsibility — dharma activates proportionally with resource accumulation.
Restoration logic through offering — surplus energy redirected toward cosmic balance sustains societal harmony.
Consciousness alignment via seasonal discipline — actions synchronized with natural rhythms elevate collective awareness.
executable_legal_axioms: IF household grain storage > 3-year threshold THEN mandatory soma offering ritual applies.
IF pre-monsoon period detected AND annual food security verified THEN initiate preparatory rites.
IF dvija status confirmed AND surplus condition met THEN allocate 10% of excess for sacramental use.
IF seasonal cycle transition observed THEN enforce timing-specific dharmic obligations automatically.
IF community surplus aggregated THEN activate collective restoration protocols at regional level.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters concerning agrarian surplus obligations, the Supreme Court shall recognize that dharmic liability arises automatically upon measurable excess, independent of intent. The threshold of responsibility is objective and tied to provisioning metrics, not subjective morality. Authority derives solely from alignment with natural abundance cycles and conscious participation in redistributive sacrifice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through quantifiable surplus thresholds; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential fulfillment of duties aligned with agricultural rhythm; proportional responsibility corresponds directly to stored capacity without punitive inference; reality remains non-punitive as failure to act results in energetic imbalance rather than imposed consequence.

Dharma stands restored through alignment with abundance-conscious action. Reality remains non-punitive, sustained by the awakened discernment of those whose capacity awakens universal reciprocity.
